note: Free primitive BLM campground in a granite-boulder canyon of the high desert south of Barstow, about 3 miles west of CA-247; known to climbers as New Jack City. Sites with shade ramadas, tables and fire pits with grills are scattered around the rock formations; three are walk-ins about 50 feet from parking. Bring water; summer highs reach 100-120 F, and a campfire permit is required. OHV riding is not allowed (OHVs must be trailered in and out). --Claude
